messages:
maria: Quick check — support team wants to pilot Sessionly (session replay/support tool). Vendor: https://sessionly.example/privacy. Request: 3 support reps + 2 devs, 30d trial. Main asks: field-level redaction, strip headers/cookies, retention, export controls. Can sec confirm blockers?
security-bot: automated-privacy-scan: WARNING — default replay captures form fields & network payloads. No DPA detected in vendor docs.
sam: @maria that's the request. We'll only surface paid customer sessions. Any immediate no-go items?
irene: checklist (quick):
1) DPA / Data Processing Addendum signed
2) SSO + SCIM provisioning (no personal accounts)
3) Field-level masking for inputs (credit card, SSN, emails)
4) Retention <= 30 days for raw replays
5) Disable network capture for /api/* or strip sensitive headers
6) Export/audit controls + disable bulk export
7) Least-privilege access + admin-only settings
If vendor can meet these, we can approve a limited trial. Please post screenshots of settings.
alex: note — ensure Authorization and cookie headers are never sent. We can add a proxy rule to strip them. Example quick config:
```
filters:
  - url_regex: '/api/.*'
    remove_headers: ['Authorization','Cookie']
    mask_inputs: true
```
maria: Vendor replied: supports field masking via CSS selectors & regex; can disable network capture; legal wants DPA signed. Contact: jane@sessionly.com
irene: conditional approval: 30-day pilot limited to Okta group `support_reps` + 2 devs. Admins only. Requirements before rollout:
- enforce SSO
- set masking to include patterns for emails, cc numbers, SSNs
- retention = 30d
- disable session export or require audit logging
Please create a JIRA access request and attach screenshots; Security will help sign DPA with Legal.
sam: will open JIRA. thanks. :thumbsup:
security-bot: flagged: 'session replay may capture pasted content' — ensure "maskPastedText" / input masking is on.
alex: I'll add middleware to scrub PII client-side and server-side. Example scrub regex for emails:
```
re_email = "[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\\.[A-Za-z]{2,}"
```
and we'll also strip `Authorization` before any network capture.
sam: updating JIRA: https://jira.redwood/ACCESS-3321 — marked blocked until DPA + SSO enforced.
maria: onboarding notes: once DPA signed we'll rotate keys, enforce SSO, and scope access. I'll post the config screenshots in ACCESS-3321 and tag @irene. (update: trial started once above completed)
irene: final note — if we ever ship session metadata to analytics (BigQuery), PII must be tokenized/hashed and retention mirrored. Approving pilot under these constraints. Monitor for any full-replay leaks.
